name: Motioneye
tagline: A web frontend for the motion daemon.
description: motionEye is a web-based frontend for motion. Check out the wiki for more details. Changelog is available on the releases page. https://github.com/motioneye-project/motioneye

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  motioneye:
    container_name: motioneye
    image: ccrisan/motioneye:master-amd64
    ports:
      - target: 8765
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /etc/motioneye
      - type: bind
        source: ${SHARED_DIR}/Media/motioneye
        target: /var/lib/motioneye
    network_mode: bridge
    privileged: false
